name: CSS Paragon
note: R13.28A, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.68 (PDF p.69) - the SAME SHEET as the DE, which draws one hull and gives it two ship data tables. Every box is the DE's and was counted once, there: shields 20 all round, C hull 10, warp 8 a side, crew 24, boarding parties 8, deck crews 2, four plasma-D racks at FH/FH/LS/RS, four shuttle boxes with two ready racks. ONLY THREE THINGS DIFFER, which is why this is its own file rather than a refit: service year 175 rather than 171, point value 100 rather than 88, and FULL aegis rather than the DE's limited. The sheet says so plainly - INCLUDES Y175 REFIT and INCLUDES FULL AEGIS - so the Y175 upgrade is baked into the 100 and must NOT be offered again, or a buyer pays for it twice. Same shape as the FFA against the FFE, and modelled the same way because R13.28A is its own reference with its own point value. The Y180 Sabot refit (+4.5) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 lives in Module R10, out of scope.
